from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to the task."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The identified legal cause of action or case nature (e.g., 'Administrative Penalty', 'Work Injury Recognition')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
